final_response.answer: Take the CS‑focused electives that count toward the Cryptography and Cybersecurity option: CS 2505 (Intro to Computer Organization), MATH 4176 and MATH 4175 (Cryptography), and MATH 2534 (Intro to Discrete Mathematics). For the Secure Computing major, add CS 4264 (Principles of Computer Security), CS 3714 (Mobile Software Development), and CS 3754 (Cloud Software Development). Those courses line up with a cybersecurity track.
